subject.title: feat(github-copilot): add native web search for Copilot GPT models

question: Should eligible unpinned GitHub Copilot Responses models automatically use subscription-hosted web search instead of the current managed-search route?
rationale: The implementation is correct and conservatively gated, but it intentionally changes default provider behavior for existing eligible users.

options.title: Enable automatic native search
options.body: Land the account-and-model-gated route so eligible users receive Copilot-hosted search without configuring another provider key.

options.title: Require explicit opt-in
options.body: Keep managed search as the default until maintainers approve a separate explicit opt-in surface.

options.title: Keep managed search only
options.body: Decline the feature if GitHub's account-capability contract is not considered stable enough for automatic routing.

recommendation.title: Enable automatic native search
recommendation.body: Land the account-and-model-gated route so eligible users receive Copilot-hosted search without configuring another provider key.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent merged work owns the Copilot authentication, provider registration, request-header, and payload boundaries most directly affected by this routing choice.
